evidence: 2026-09-30: real signup through the Agent Vault proxy using this recipe (MCP session, vault-minted password). After the email, a name and new-password step appeared, then a confirm-password field after the first submit; with both filled the account was accepted and Vimeo's "Verify your email address" mail arrived at the signup address. The account owner opened its link, and a fresh sign-in with the same credentials was then accepted.
gotchas: Email-first, one screen for log-in and sign-up: after the email, a new account gets a name and new-password step (#password_login), and a confirm-password field appears after the first submit. The account is confirmed by a link sent by email, which belongs to the account owner.

After the email is entered, "Continue with email" can stay disabled for a minute or more while an hCaptcha frame runs in the background; on 2026-09-30 it passed on its own and the next step appeared without anyone solving anything.
The new-account step has an optional checkbox to receive updates; it was left unticked.
